* Submit estimated pickup times for QR_REDEMPTION products in an order * * This endpoint allows consumers to provide estimated pickup times for their QR redemption items. * Each merchant order within the main order can have its own pickup time. After successful * submission, QR redemption emails with embedded QR codes are automatically sent to the consumer. * * @param orderId - The main order ID containing QR_REDEMPTION products * @param body - Contains array of pickup times with merchantOrderId and estimatedPickupTime * @returns Success response with confirmation details * * Business Rules: * - Only works with COMPLETED orders that contain QR_REDEMPTION products * - User must be the order owner (consumer) * - Pickup times are stored in merchantOrder.customFields.estimatedPickupTime * - Triggers automatic QR redemption email generation with QR codes * - Supports batch submission for multiple merchant orders in single request *

Unlike the batch submission endpoint, this * updates a single merchant order and preserves other existing customFields data. * * @param merchantOrderId - The specific merchant order ID to update * @param body - Contains the new estimatedPickupTime value * @returns Success response with updated pickup time details * * Business Rules: * - User must be the owner of the order containing this merchant order * - Merchant order must contain QR_REDEMPTION products * - Updates merchantOrder.customFields.estimatedPickupTime while preserving other fields * - Supports any text format for pickup time (flexible user input) * - Does not trigger additional email sending (unlike initial submission) * * Use Cases: * - Consumer changes their mind about pickup time * - Store provides more specific pickup instructions * - Scheduling conflicts require time adjustments * - Consumer wants to add additional pickup details

POST /posts/curator/toggle-sync POST /posts/curator/toggle-sync toggleSync ▸

* Toggle sync between Post and its source (Event/Product/etc.) * * Supports two mutually exclusive modes: * 1. **Update mode (postId)**: Toggle sync for existing Event Post * 2. **Preview mode (eventId)**: Query sync fields before creating Event Post * * @param body - Toggle sync request with syncEnabled and either postId or eventId * @returns Toggle sync response OR sync preview response * * @remarks * **Update Mode (postId)**: * - Validates post ownership and original post requirement * - Syncs current post and its direct resale posts (if syncEnabled=true) * - Does NOT sync all posts associated with the event * - Resale posts are only synced if their syncEnabled = true * * **Preview Mode (eventId)**: * - Query-only operation (no database writes) * - Returns all fields that would be synced from Event * - Used by frontend to display sync preview before creating post * - syncEnabled must be true (preview only makes sense when enabling sync) * * **Frontend Confirmation**: * - Frontend must show confirmation dialog before calling this API * - Backend executes operation synchronously and returns updated data * * @example * // Update mode: Enable sync for existing post * POST /posts/curator/toggle-sync * { syncEnabled: true, postId: 'post-uuid' } * * @example * // Preview mode: Query sync fields for event * POST /posts/curator/toggle-sync * { syncEnabled: true, eventId: 'event-uuid' }

请求体 application/json：ToggleSyncRequest

PUT /posts/admin/{id}/apply-rates-to-resale-posts PUT /posts/admin/{id}/apply-rates-to-resale-posts applyRatesToResalePosts ▸

* Apply commission rates and wholesale prices from a parent post to all downstream resale posts. * * This endpoint provides a clear, explicit action for admin to cascade pricing changes * to all resale posts, separate from the post update operation. This improves UX by: * - Making it clear what changes are being applied (rates only, not all settings) * - Separating configuration updates from cascade actions * - Providing feedback on which posts were affected * * Use Cases: * 1. Admin updates commission rate on original post, then applies to all resellers * 2. Ops team needs to correct rates across an entire resale chain * 3. Bulk rate adjustments for seasonal promotions * * Important Notes: * - Only affects posts where allowPromotersSetPrice = false (commission mode) * - Updates are recursive (affects all downstream posts in the chain) * - All changes validated before committing (atomic transaction) * - Post must have allowPromotersResell = true * * @route PUT /posts/admin/:id/apply-rates-to-resale-posts * @param postId - The parent post whose rates should be applied to children * @returns Count of updated posts and list of affected post IDs * @throws BadRequestException if post does not allow reselling * @throws ResourceNotFound if post not found * * @example * PUT /posts/admin/abc-123/apply-rates-to-resale-posts * Response: { updatedPostCount: 5, affectedPostIds: [...] }

* Synchronizes a specific product in a post with its catalog version. * * This endpoint enables the "Sync with Catalog" feature for operations team. * Use case: When a product in the catalog is updated (e.g., new color/size variants added), * ops can click this button to pull those changes into the post without manually editing. * * The sync process: * - Fetches latest product data from catalog * - Keeps existing variant prices/settings unchanged * - Adds new variants with calculated default prices * - Maintains post's financial model (wholesale/commission) * * @route PUT /posts/admin/:id/sync-product/:productId * @param postId - The post ID containing the product * @param productId - The product ID to sync with catalog * @returns Updated post data after synchronization * @throws ResourceNotFound if post or product not found

* Batch counterpart of {@link productDetailPublic}. Lets a consumer page * fetch full PDP details for many products in a single request, avoiding * browser per-host concurrency limits when a post has lots of related * products.
